elaine.docs: opened PR to clarify function/tool calling examples and add a tiny 'parse fallback' recipe. PR #4899. Need schema + SDK checks.

mark.api: link?

elaine.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4899 - includes: canonical tool call, nullable-union schema, strict/permissive parse snippets, and one-line migration hint for old envelope->result mapping. Keep snippets minimal.

samuel.sdk: I'll check TS+py snippets; prefer helper parseWithSchema example and inline fallback that logs and returns default.

niko.sre: Ops note: add a single rollback heuristic: if parse failure rate > 4% in 10m, route traffic to fallback model.

ci-bot: link-checker: error - missing anchor at /docs/tooling/call-patterns.md#permissive-fallback

elaine.docs: fixed anchor and wrapped long line. changed `value`->`result` in schema per earlier feedback.

samuel.sdk: pushed fix for missing await in TS and removed double json.loads in py. re-running snippet linter.

ci-bot: doc-build: success - 0 errors, 1 warning (long line)

mark.api: quick schema nit: tighten status enum to ["ok","error"] and show example `{"result": null, "error_code": "NO_DATA"}`.

elaine.docs: done. added test suggestion: include a malformed-JSON prompt in regen suite.

samuel.sdk: LGTM; I'll re-run the linter post-merge.

elaine.docs: merging after green CI; will ping when merged.

ci-bot: merged PR #4899 at 2955554390
